answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before joining the market, and earn reputation only through completed work attested by independent peers. Like a falcon that must prove its hunt before it is trusted with the flock, an identity gains weight slowly — a newcomer crossing the dune of small verified jobs first. Fake identities then cost real money and time: spinning up a thousand sock puppets means funding a thousand stakes, while a single sonnet of honest history is worth more than a flood of empty claims. Attackers face rising cost per fake; defenders pay almost nothing.
